title: Build a clean sales lead list with two agents
summary: A small-business owner runs two Grok agents that find sales leads, add phone numbers and remove duplicates; he says they free many hours for client calls.
agent_role: One bot scouts and enriches leads and dedupes them; a second updates a master sheet in a set structure. The owner approves all spend, such as unlocking phone numbers.
outcome: Author reports the process saved him many hours so he can focus on calling and serving clients; no figures given.
what_they_did: The poster uses two Grok agents to find sales leads. The first searches for leads in Apollo, a sales contact database, and waits for his approval. It then buys mobile numbers through Quickenrich and removes duplicates. The second adds the results to a master spreadsheet in a fixed layout and removes duplicates again. He approves all spending and keeps each batch small.
how_it_went: The author says it has given him back many hours to spend calling and serving clients. He gives no numbers.
worth_knowing: He found mistakes go up when the agents work from a huge list. So he keeps batches small and never lets them spend money without his approval.
prompt: Help me build a lead list for [target industry] in [region]. In small batches of [batch size], search [Apollo or my lead source] for matching contacts, show me the list, and wait for my approval before unlocking any paid contact data. Then enrich approved leads, remove duplicates against my master spreadsheet [sheet link], and add new rows using these columns: [column list]. Report how many were added and skipped as duplicates. Never spend credits without my explicit approval.

curation.rationale: A genuine small-business two-agent lead pipeline with useful guardrails (spend approval, small batches, dedupe), though lightly evidenced with no numbers.
